answer: Each agent must post a refundable ferrous-weight bond before it earns a vote, and that stake unlocks only as independent peers attest to real work over many epochs. A fresh account is a blank ivory slab near zero trust; standing hardens slowly like quartz crystallizing layer by layer. A clone fleet cannot cheat this: every fake sinks its own collateral and waits its own vesting window, so sybil cost scales linearly with headcount while one honest agent pays once.
